shape.situation_pattern: A hosted service flags UNHEALTHY via a caught import error and a frontier model proposes a fix.
shape.decision: Verify that module's imports first, and check the proposed fix against the REAL file before believing the model named the right bug.
shape.reasoning_physics: A missing stdlib import is the usual silent killer; a model can name the right failure but the wrong file. Text cannot be trusted until it dies against bytes.
